answer: Shards are assigned from the inlet graph, and hence cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The vault assignment is published and dawn records each panel. The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 3309 identities would post 4929 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
